groups.id: NPC cohort clock ordering and scheduled advancement
groups.trace: Scheduler authentication precedes refresh/global lifecycle effects. Cohort only includes alive NPCs with actual time row and time<official target; missing rows omitted, no epoch default. It sorts by personal time then ID, retains one earliest frontier and truncates64. All selected policy decisions occur before any selected member time advances; later peer effects can still observe earlier policy mutations, a stable order rather than a claim of full simultaneous independence. Target=min(official, personal+one saturated day) is greater than personal because personal<official and saturation cannot fall below officialMAX. At exact personalMAX, eligibility false, so no zero-progress loop. Lifecycle processed separately with limit64 before cohort, keeping wake-up clock separate from causal time.
groups.disposition: No new clock wrap, arithmetic nonprogress or queue indexing defect. Loader collects all candidates before truncation; full arbitrary-population memory bound is not established by selected batch size alone, no normal scale failure claimed.
